outcome: length of stay (LOS) in neonatal intensive care units (NICUs)
cohort: The study enrolled 333 neonates admitted to the NICU of Gadarif Hospital in Eastern Sudan and discharged alive.
finding: Increasing maternal age, preterm delivery, low birth weight, a low Apgar score, and increasing white blood cell count were associated with a prolonged length of stay in the NICU, while parity was inversely associated.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was associated with length of stay only in the univariate analysis, not the multivariate analysis.
birth_weight: Includes low birth weight (LBW) neonates (42%) and neonates of other birth weights.
gest_age: Includes preterm neonates (39.9%) and term neonates.
